title: Instruction-Free Dataflow Fabric: Deterministic Multi-Model Inference on a Configurable Spatial Dataflow Fabric for Real-Time Edge Systems
description:
Public research record for a fixed hardware skeleton that any CNN within its range can be configured to become, running as a circuit with no instruction processor in the inference loop. A compiler turns each model into configuration, routing, memory and a static schedule, so worst-case latency is known before inference, even when several models share the chip.

Contents: research proposal, core message and testable claims, and result figures from early simulations (multi-model composability; which CNNs a skeleton can become). Version 0.1 of this record also contains the early simulation code.
